description: This PHP source file defines the MailAttachmentMIME class, which extends the mimetype class to detect MIME types based on file extension. It includes the mimetype class implementation with a method to determine MIME types from filenames, and the MailAttachmentMIME class adds a static detect method for MIME type detection.
